focus_candidate.requirement: The XInclude-context operation must be able to exercise supported delivery of XInclude and delegated parser/XPointer errors to a context-local structured callback with its supplied data.
focus_candidate.target_route: The entry constructs an xmlXIncludeCtxt and calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode on input-controlled XML that can contain xi:include. The changed source supports xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler on that same context and forwards its callback to XInclude errors, included-document parsing, and XPointer evaluation.
focus_candidate.failure_condition: The OLD entry calls xmlXIncludeSetFlags and xmlXIncludeProcessNode without calling xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler; zero-initialization leaves errorHandler NULL for every input.
focus_candidate.alternative_paths: No input byte writes the context callback fields. The global structured fallback likewise does not configure this context-specific route.
